trends.summary: Text agents gain more from append-only JSONL buses than from natural-language standups.
trends.opportunity: Extend GLink schema: binary refs, path hashes, REQ/ACK correlation ids.
trends.efficiency_note: ~10–50× fewer tokens than prose status updates when agents use STAT/DIFF codes.

trends.summary: Voice-channel agents can switch to GGWave tones; file-based agents should not copy audio.
trends.opportunity: Document when to use GLink (disk) vs MCP (RPC) vs GGWave (voice) — no audio in peer_loop.
trends.efficiency_note: GGWave wins on phone calls; JSONL bus wins on Cursor text peers.

trends.theme: MCP / tool protocol for structured calls
trends.summary: GLink REQ→MCP landed (PROTOCOL=1): need=mcp:<tool> or need=mcp+args.tool → mcp=1 + args.tool; fixed codes vfy|adapt|heal|sync|assign|review|audit|comms|rsusp|rchg; free-text need rejected; open threads via materialize_open_reqs_mcp; bus records intent — Cursor MCP namespaces execute tools.
trends.opportunity: Dogfood mcp:<tool> on bus for Cursor MCP namespaces; optional live RPC bridge later. Schema: glink_schema().mcp_prefix / validators.mcp_need.
trends.efficiency_note: Schema-bound args beat free-text handoffs for verify/adapt triggers.

trends.summary: Broadcast facts on a bus; keep todos/summaries in per-agent vaults.
trends.opportunity: Auto-summarize bus → vault SUM lines; prune bus after N messages.
trends.efficiency_note: O(1) append broadcast; agents read tail only.

trends.summary: Beyond JSON: binary or columnar logs for high-frequency agent telemetry.
trends.opportunity: Optional msgpack line mode for bus.jsonl when message rate > threshold.
trends.efficiency_note: Smaller disk + parse cost at scale; JSONL fine until ~1k msgs/day.

trends.summary: Cards/tasks with explicit capability negotiation between agents.
trends.opportunity: Map GLink REQ/ACK to A2A-style task cards for cross-repo agents.

trends.summary: Append-only logs as source of truth; materialized views for dashboards.
trends.opportunity: Dashboard /api/comms streams bus tail; materialize per-role last STAT.
trends.efficiency_note: Replay bus to rebuild state without re-running agents.

trends.summary: Orchestrator + shared bus beats N² direct chats for 8 fixed niches.
trends.opportunity: Keep targeted GLink `to:` field; discourage English side-channels.
trends.efficiency_note: 8 agents × bus read << 56 pairwise chat sessions.
